Replace information in a pain drawing list-column

Source: R/pdr_put_info.R
pdr_put_info.Rd

Updates elements within a pain drawing list-column. The function allows either replacing an entire named element or replacing a named sub-element within a non-atomic element.

Usage

pdr_put_info(pdr_list, replacement, e1 = NULL, e2 = NULL)

Arguments

pdr_list

A pain drawing list-column, typically a list-column in a tibble, suited for a mutate() function call. Each element is expected to be a named list containing pain drawing data.

replacement

The replacement data. Must have the same length as pdr_list, or have length one, in which case the same replacement is recycled across all elements.

e1

A character string specifying the name of the element to replace in each pain drawing.

e2

An optional character string specifying the name of a nested element to replace within e1. Used when the element specified by e1 is non-atomic.

Value

A modified pain drawing list-column with the same number of elements as pdr_list.

Details

The function is intended for use with list-columns containing pain drawing data, where each list element is a named list of components such as .id, .filename, and .strokes.

If the element specified by e1 is atomic (e.g. a character vector, numeric vector, or logical vector), it is replaced directly. If it is non-atomic (e.g. a tibble or another list), the element specified by e2 is replaced instead.

The function uses purrr::map2() to iterate over the original elements and their corresponding replacement values.

If e1 is NULL, or the lengths of pdr_list and replacement are incompatible, a warning is issued and NA is returned.

Examples

# Replace the .id element in each pain drawing
pdr_list <- list(
  list(.id = "a", .filename = "drawing1.svg"),
  list(.id = "b", .filename = "drawing2.svg")
)

pdr_put_info(pdr_list, replacement = c("x", "y"), e1 = ".id")
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]]$.id
#> [1] "x"
#> 
#> [[1]]$.filename
#> [1] "drawing1.svg"
#> 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [[2]]$.id
#> [1] "y"
#> 
#> [[2]]$.filename
#> [1] "drawing2.svg"
#> 
#> 

# Replace the .filename element in each pain drawing
pdr_put_info(pdr_list, replacement = "new.svg", e1 = ".filename")
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]]$.id
#> [1] "a"
#> 
#> [[1]]$.filename
#> [1] "new.svg"
#> 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [[2]]$.id
#> [1] "b"
#> 
#> [[2]]$.filename
#> [1] "new.svg"
#> 
#>
